feature: Make Product Action Buttons Always Visible on Touch Devices
workflow_rationale: This is a straightforward CSS fix affecting only frontend UI components. No backend changes, no dependencies, no complex integration. Simple workflow is appropriate for quick, isolated UI improvements.

phases.name: UI Accessibility Fix
phases.description: Update opacity classes in dashboard pages to make action buttons always visible

subtasks.description: Update ProductListItem action buttons in products page
subtasks.implementation_notes: Change line 140 from 'opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100' to 'opacity-70 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100' or remove opacity-0 entirely for always-visible buttons

checks: Action buttons (edit, delete) are visible without hover
Buttons still have hover effect (opacity increase or background change)

subtasks.notes: Changed action buttons from opacity-0 to opacity-70 in ProductListItem component. Buttons are now always visible on touch devices while maintaining hover effect (opacity increases to 100 on hover). Change committed successfully.

subtasks.description: Update CategoryTreeNode action buttons in categories page
subtasks.implementation_notes: Change line 101 with same pattern as products page - ensure consistency across dashboard pages

checks: Action buttons (edit, delete) are visible without hover
Hierarchical category tree still renders correctly

subtasks.notes: Updated CategoryTreeNode action buttons opacity from opacity-0 to opacity-70, making buttons always visible with 70% opacity that increases to 100% on hover. This matches the pattern used in products page and improves accessibility on touch devices.

subtasks.description: Update table action buttons in tables page
subtasks.implementation_notes: Change line 150 with same pattern for consistency

checks: Action buttons are visible without hover
QR code download buttons work correctly

subtasks.notes: Changed action buttons opacity from opacity-0 to opacity-70 to match the pattern in products page. Buttons are now always visible at 70% opacity and transition to 100% on hover, improving touch device accessibility.

subtasks.description: Update arrow indicator in audit page (optional enhancement)
subtasks.implementation_notes: Change line 459 - this is less critical (just an arrow icon), but improves consistency
subtasks.notes: Updated arrow indicator opacity from 0 to 70 to match products page pattern. Arrow indicators are now always visible (70% opacity) and become fully visible on hover, improving touch device accessibility.

parallelism.speedup_estimate: No parallelism needed - simple sequential UI changes

acceptance_criteria: Action buttons are visible on all dashboard pages without hovering
Buttons remain accessible on touch devices (tablets, phones)
Hover effects still work for desktop users
No visual regressions in UI layout

verification_steps.name: Visual Verification
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Start dev server and manually test each dashboard page on touch simulation

verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk CSS-only change. No functional logic affected, no backend changes, no database changes. Manual browser testing sufficient to verify accessibility improvement.

checks: Edit and delete buttons work correctly

touch_device_simulation.instructions: Use Chrome DevTools device emulation to test on iPad/tablet viewport. Verify buttons are discoverable without hover capability.
